scope: Photographic cover selection, secondary-story composition, and local discovery controls

photography.approach: Reselect existing approved, credited documentary assets for the cover. Do not replace guide photographs with unrelated scenery.
photography.delivery: Lead image sizes account for landscape photographs filling a tall cover, rather than requesting only the narrow displayed column width.
photography.rights: Existing source and rights records retained unchanged. No new license assertion.

composition.secondaryColumn: 40 percent of photographic canvas, approximately 351 pixels at a 1440 pixel viewport
composition.secondaryCaptions: Below photographs on the existing paper colour, not overlaid on subjects
composition.credits: 10 pixel credits, wrapping when necessary, directly linked to source in a new tab
composition.motion: Removed staggered figure entrance on manual edition changes. Existing reduced-motion behavior retained.

localDiscovery.place: Native labelled select, visually integrated with editorial typography
localDiscovery.time: Native radio group with visible 44 pixel minimum touch targets
verified: London plus short visit submits correct country, region, time and results fragment and returns five guides.
Arrow keys move between time choices.
Changing to Wadi Rum clears unsupported time and disables unavailable options.
No geolocation or account requirement added.

checks.creditHitTesting: All three current cover credits were topmost clickable targets at their centre.

limits: A visual and functional refinement, not a measured engagement or retention experiment. This pass curates the homepage cover, not a replacement of every photograph in the catalogue.
